timeline.label: The start
timeline.text: Started a cleaning business with one client and no system.

timeline.label: The hard part
timeline.text: Did every job, every quote and every invoice alone, and hit a ceiling.

timeline.label: The fix
timeline.text: Put the business on a system, hired the first cleaner and handed over the work.

timeline.label: Today
timeline.text: Runs a team, and teaches the same steps to 300+ owners through Home Service Hub.
